summary.en: One turn in a conversation. Your words sit in an accent bubble on the right; the assistant answers as plain reading text in the column, with a quiet actions row under it. System lines are centered footnotes.
summary.id: Satu giliran dalam percakapan. Kata-kata Anda ada di bubble aksen di kanan; asisten menjawab dengan teks baca biasa di kolom, dengan baris aksi yang tenang di bawahnya. Baris sistem berupa footnote di tengah.

en.title: Your message and the answer
en.desc: The person speaks in the accent bubble; the answer is plain text in the column, which is easier to read at length and to copy. Press copy to see the icon swap.
en.html:
What is the difference between mitosis and meiosis?
09:41
Mitosis makes two cells that are copies of the parent, for growth and repair. Meiosis makes four cells with half the chromosomes each, for reproduction, and shuffles genes on the way so each cell is different.

en.title: An answer with sources and code
en.desc: Long answers use prose inside the bubble for paragraph spacing; sources are citations; inline code wraps instead of overflowing.
en.html:
How do I count the rows in the grades table?

Use SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grades; to count every row, including rows with empty scores.1

To count only graded work, name the column: COUNT(score) skips rows where the score is empty.2

en.title: Meta: time, edited, not sent
en.desc: Meta is one caption line. A message that failed says so in words under the bubble with a way to retry; nothing else turns red.
en.html:
Remind me what is due on Friday.
Also the lab report, please.
Edited
And the reading for week 6.
errorNot sent. You are offline.

en.title: System line
en.desc: Centered footnote text, no bubble. For what the conversation did, not for what someone said.
en.html: You switched to exam mode. Hints stay hidden until you submit.

id.title: Pesan Anda dan jawabannya
id.desc: Orang berbicara di bubble aksen; jawaban berupa teks biasa di kolom, lebih mudah dibaca panjang dan disalin. Tekan salin untuk melihat icon swap.
id.html:
Apa beda mitosis dan meiosis?
09.41
Mitosis menghasilkan dua sel yang sama persis dengan sel induk, untuk pertumbuhan dan perbaikan. Meiosis menghasilkan empat sel yang masing-masing berisi separuh kromosom, untuk reproduksi, dan mengacak gen di prosesnya sehingga setiap sel berbeda.

id.title: Jawaban dengan sumber dan kode
id.desc: Jawaban panjang memakai prose di dalam bubble untuk jarak paragraf; sumber berupa sitasi; kode inline terlipat, tidak meluber.
id.html:
Bagaimana cara menghitung jumlah baris di tabel nilai?

Pakai SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grades; untuk menghitung semua baris, termasuk baris dengan nilai kosong.1

Untuk menghitung tugas yang sudah dinilai saja, sebut kolomnya: COUNT(score) melewati baris yang nilainya kosong.2

id.html:

id.desc: Teks footnote di tengah, tanpa bubble. Untuk hal yang dilakukan percakapan, bukan untuk ucapan seseorang.
